description: FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators lined up with this run's check results: which are validated, which are failing, and which this project does not cover. It lists the evidence files it rests on, each with its fingerprint.

indicators.name: Reviewing All Training
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of relevant cybersecurity education and training is persistently reviewed, including at least general training for all employees, role-specific training for employees in high risk roles, training for development and engineering staff on secure software delivery, and training for staff involved with incident response or disaster recovery.

findings: security group secuguard-planted-analytics: not in the approved baseline (declared out-of-scope)
security group secuguard-planted-open-admin: not in the approved baseline (declared out-of-scope)
security group secuguard-planted-unclassified: not in the approved baseline (declared with no scope)
checks.title: The network matches the approved scope baseline
Account activity is recorded and the record is protected
Every change to the account's resources is recorded

indicators.covers: AWS Config records every change to resources, CloudTrail records who made it, and scope changes are compared with an approved baseline.
indicators.does_not_cover: Review of those logs by a person or an alerting system.
indicators.name: Logging Changes
indicators.statement: Modifications to the cloud service offering are logged and monitored.

indicators.name: Redeploying vs Modifying
indicators.statement: Changes to machine-based information resources are executed through the redeployment of version controlled resources rather than direct modification wherever reasonable.

indicators.name: Reviewing Change Procedures
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of documented change management procedures is persistently reviewed.

indicators.covers: Planned changes are validated by automated rules before deployment, and the deployed result is checked again on the next run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Testing during deployment itself, such as staged rollouts.
indicators.name: Validating Throughout Deployment
indicators.statement: Persistent testing and validation of changes throughout deployment is automated.

indicators.name: Defining Functionality and Privileges
indicators.statement: The functionality and privileges for infrastructure and services are strictly defined.

findings: security group secuguard-planted-analytics: declared out-of-scope, but it can reach the card data zone (port 5432 on secuguard-cde), so PCI DSS applies to it
checks.title: Declared PCI scope matches the firewall rules

findings: account: Security Hub is not switched on, so nothing is evaluating the account against a standard
checks.title: The account is evaluated continuously against a security standard

indicators.covers: Declared PCI scope is compared with actual connectivity, and Security Hub evaluates the account against a standard.
indicators.does_not_cover: Automatic correction. Drift is reported, not reverted.
indicators.name: Enforcing Intended State
indicators.statement: Class B: **Optional:** Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state. Class C: Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state.

indicators.name: Implementing Best Practices
indicators.statement: The use and configuration of third-party machine-based information resources is persistently compared against the original provider's best practices and guidance.

findings: security group secuguard-planted-open-admin (sg-e1003d6a40009d65c): open to the whole internet: SSH (port 22)
checks.title: No administrative port is open to the internet
Default security groups allow nothing

findings: bucket secuguard-legacy-exports-123456789012: public access protections switched off: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
checks.title: Storage cannot be made public
The card data zone has no route to the internet

indicators.covers: Default firewall groups, internet-facing administrative ports, public storage settings, and internet routes are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Software and services running on servers. This environment has no servers.
indicators.name: Minimizing Attack Surface
indicators.statement: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they have a minimal attack surface and that lateral movement is minimized if compromised.

indicators.name: Optimizing for Availability
indicators.statement: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately optimized for high availability and rapid recovery.

findings: security group secuguard-planted-open-admin (sg-e1003d6a40009d65c): open to the whole internet: SSH (port 22)
checks.title: No administrative port is open to the internet

findings: security group secuguard-cde (sg-cf8635368ad008a71): accepts traffic from sg-3727fc01f0fee94b2, tagged out-of-scope
checks.title: The card data zone accepts traffic only from in-scope systems
The card data zone has no route to the internet

indicators.covers: Firewall rules are read on every run and checked for administrative ports open to the internet, for what may enter the card data zone, and for routes to the internet.
indicators.does_not_cover: Outbound traffic rules, and anything enforced outside AWS security groups and route tables.
indicators.name: Restricting Network Traffic
indicators.statement: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately configured to limit inbound and outbound network traffic.

indicators.name: Reviewing Protections
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of protection against denial of service attacks and other unwanted activity for machine-based information resources is persistently reviewed.

findings: security group secuguard-cde (sg-cf8635368ad008a71): accepts traffic from sg-3727fc01f0fee94b2, tagged out-of-scope
checks.title: The card data zone accepts traffic only from in-scope systems

findings: security group secuguard-planted-analytics: declared out-of-scope, but it can reach the card data zone (port 5432 on secuguard-cde), so PCI DSS applies to it
checks.title: Declared PCI scope matches the firewall rules

indicators.covers: The network is split into labelled zones, and the labels are compared with the real firewall rules on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Network controls inside a zone, between systems that share a security group.
indicators.name: Using Logical Networking
indicators.statement: Logical networking and related capabilities are used and persistently reviewed to enforce traffic flow controls.

indicators.name: Automating Account Management
indicators.statement: The lifecycle and privileges of all accounts, roles, and groups are securely managed using automation.

findings: root user: MFA is not on
checks.title: The root user has MFA
A strong password policy is set

findings: user secuguard-dev-alice: can sign in to the console with a password and no MFA
checks.title: Every user who can sign in has MFA

indicators.covers: Root user MFA, MFA for every user with a console password, and the password policy are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Whether the MFA in use is phishing-resistant, and identities managed in IAM Identity Center.
indicators.name: Adopting Passwordless Methods
indicators.statement: Secure passwordless methods are used for user authentication and authorization when feasible, otherwise strong passwords with phishing-resistant MFA is used.

checks.title: The root user has no access keys

findings: user secuguard-svc-reports: has AdministratorAccess attached directly
checks.title: No user holds administrator rights directly

findings: role secuguard-legacy-vendor: trusts outside account 127311923021 with no external ID
checks.title: Outside accounts need an external ID to use a role

indicators.covers: Users with administrator rights attached directly, root access keys, and roles that outside accounts may use are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Whether each identity's rights are the minimum its job needs. That takes a review of each policy.
indicators.name: Ensuring Least Privilege
indicators.statement: Identity and access management measures are used and persistently reviewed to ensure each user or device can only access the resources they need.

indicators.name: Authorizing Just-in-Time
indicators.statement: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time security authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for all user and non-user accounts and services.

findings: user secuguard-svc-reports access key ending YL67: active but has never been used
checks.title: Access keys are in use and not stale

findings: role secuguard-legacy-vendor: trusts outside account 127311923021 with no external ID
checks.title: Outside accounts need an external ID to use a role

indicators.covers: Access keys that are unused or older than 90 days, and outside-account trust, are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Automatic disabling. Stale credentials are reported, not switched off.
indicators.name: Securing Non-User Authentication
indicators.statement: Appropriately secure authentication methods are used and persistently reviewed for non-user accounts and services.

indicators.name: Responding to Suspicious Activity
indicators.statement: Accounts with privileged access are disabled or otherwise secured in response to suspicious activity.

indicators.name: Generating After Action Reports
indicators.statement: Incident after action reports are generated and lessons learned are persistently incorporated.

indicators.name: Reviewing Incident Response Procedures
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of documented incident response procedures is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Reviewing Past Incidents
indicators.statement: Past incidents are persistently reviewed for patterns or vulnerabilities that were not previously apparent or identified.

indicators.name: Authorizing Log Access
indicators.statement: Class B: **Optional:** A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data based on organizationally defined data sensitivity. Class C: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data based on organizationally defined data sensitivity.

findings: account: Security Hub is not switched on, so nothing is evaluating the account against a standard
checks.title: The account is evaluated continuously against a security standard

indicators.covers: Every planned Terraform change is tested against rules before it is applied, and Security Hub evaluates the running account.
indicators.does_not_cover: Enforcement on every change. The plan check is run by choice on the author's computer until it is wired into GitHub.
indicators.name: Evaluating Configurations
indicators.statement: The configuration of machine-based information resources, especially infrastructure as code, is persistently evaluated and tested.

findings: VPC default (vpc-434d96aa41c404b26): no flow logs, so network traffic is not recorded
checks.title: Network traffic is logged
Account activity is recorded and the record is protected

indicators.covers: CloudTrail and network flow logging are checked on every run, including whether the trail covers every region and validates its files.
indicators.does_not_cover: A written list of which event types are logged and why.
indicators.name: Logging Event Types
indicators.statement: A list of information resources and event types that will be logged, monitored, and audited is maintained and persistently reviewed to ensure these activities occur.

indicators.name: Operating SIEM Capability
indicators.statement: A Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or similar system(s) is used and persistently reviewed for centralized, tamper-resistant logging of events, activities, and changes.

indicators.name: Reviewing Logs
indicators.statement: Logs are persistently reviewed and audited.

findings: security group secuguard-planted-unclassified: has no PCI scope tag, so nobody has decided whether PCI DSS applies to it
checks.title: Every part of the network has a declared PCI scope

findings: security group secuguard-planted-analytics: not in the approved baseline (declared out-of-scope)
security group secuguard-planted-open-admin: not in the approved baseline (declared out-of-scope)
security group secuguard-planted-unclassified: not in the approved baseline (declared with no scope)
checks.title: The network matches the approved scope baseline
Every change to the account's resources is recorded

indicators.covers: AWS Config keeps a live inventory of resources, and each run records the network, identities, keys, certificates, and storage directly from AWS.
indicators.does_not_cover: Software, data, and anything outside this AWS account and region.
indicators.name: Generating Inventories
indicators.statement: Authoritative sources are used to automatically generate real-time inventories of all information resources when needed.

indicators.name: Reviewing Executive Support
indicators.statement: Executive support for achieving the provider's security goals is persistently reviewed and demonstrated.

indicators.name: Reviewing Investments in Security
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of the provider's investments in achieving security goals is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Reviewing Security in the SDLC
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of building security and privacy considerations into the Software Development Lifecycle and aligning with CISA Secure By Design principles is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Reviewing Vulnerability Disclosures
indicators.statement: The effectiveness of the provider's vulnerability disclosure program is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Aligning Backups with Objectives
indicators.statement: The alignment of machine-based information resource backups with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Aligning Recovery Plan
indicators.statement: The alignment of recovery plans with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Reviewing Recovery Objectives
indicators.statement: The desired Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are defined and persistently reviewed for alignment with the provider's business needs and capabilities.

indicators.name: Testing Recovery Capabilities
indicators.statement: The capability to recover from incidents and contingencies aligned with defined recovery objectives is persistently tested.

indicators.name: Mitigating Supply Chain Risk
indicators.statement: Potential supply chain risks are persistently identified, reviewed, and mitigated.

indicators.name: Monitoring Supply Chain Risk
indicators.statement: Third party software information resources are automatically monitored for upstream vulnerabilities using mechanisms that may include contractual notification requirements or active monitoring services.

indicators.name: Automating Configuration Management
indicators.statement: The configuration of machine-based information resources is managed using automation and persistently reviewed for drift.

findings: KMS key alias/secuguard-legacy-no-rotation: automatic rotation is off
checks.title: Encryption keys rotate automatically

findings: certificate legacy-api.secuguard.example: expires in 19 days, inside the 30-day warning window
checks.title: No certificate is expired or about to expire

findings: user secuguard-svc-reports access key ending YL67: active but has never been used
checks.title: Access keys are in use and not stale

indicators.covers: Encryption key rotation, certificate expiry, and access key age are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Secrets held outside AWS KMS, ACM, and IAM, such as passwords in application settings.
indicators.name: Automating Secret Management
indicators.statement: Management, protection, and regular rotation of digital keys, certificates, and other secrets is automated and persistently reviewed.

indicators.name: Evaluating and Improving Security
indicators.statement: Information resources are persistently evaluated for opportunities to improve security and those improvements are persistently made.

indicators.name: Preventing Residual Risk
indicators.statement: Class B: **Optional:** Plans, procedures, and the state of information resources are persistently reviewed after making changes to limit and remove unwanted residual elements that would likely negatively affect the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of federal customer data. Class C: Plans, procedures, and the state of information resources are persistently reviewed after making changes to limit and remove unwanted residual elements that would likely negatively affect the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of federal customer data.

indicators.name: Removing Unwanted Data
indicators.statement: Class B: **Optional:** Unwanted federal customer data is removed promptly when requested by an agency in alignment with customer agreements, including from backups if appropriate; this typically applies when a customer spills information or when a customer seeks to remove information from a service due to a change in usage. Class C: Unwanted federal customer data is removed promptly when requested by an agency in alignment with customer agreements, including from backups if appropriate; this typically applies when a customer spills information or when a customer seeks to remove information from a service due to a change in usage.

findings: bucket secuguard-legacy-exports-123456789012: not encrypted with a customer managed key (uses the AWS default)
checks.title: Storage is encrypted with keys SecuGuard controls

findings: bucket secuguard-legacy-exports-123456789012: public access protections switched off: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
checks.title: Storage cannot be made public

findings: certificate legacy-api.secuguard.example: RSA key of 1024 bits, below the 2048-bit minimum
checks.title: Certificates use strong keys and signatures

findings: load balancer secuguard-portal port 443: TLS policy ELBSecurityPolicy-2016-08 still allows TLS 1.0 or 1.1
checks.title: Connections require TLS 1.2 or newer
Compliance evidence cannot be altered or deleted

indicators.covers: Storage encryption, public access settings, certificate strength, TLS versions, and the evidence lock are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Encryption inside applications and databases. This environment has none.
indicators.name: Securing Information
indicators.statement: Information is encrypted or otherwise secured from unwanted access or modification.

findings: certificate legacy-api.secuguard.example: RSA key of 1024 bits, below the 2048-bit minimum
checks.title: Certificates use strong keys and signatures

findings: load balancer secuguard-portal port 443: TLS policy ELBSecurityPolicy-2016-08 still allows TLS 1.0 or 1.1
checks.title: Connections require TLS 1.2 or newer

findings: certificate portal.secuguard.example: self-signed, and in use by load balancer secuguard-portal. No certificate authority vouches for it.
checks.title: Certificates in use are issued by a certificate authority

indicators.covers: Certificate key strength, signature method, issuer, and the TLS policy on each listener are checked on every run.
indicators.does_not_cover: Connections between systems inside the network, which are not inspected.
indicators.name: Validating Communications
indicators.statement: Class B: **Optional:** The authenticity and integrity of communications between machine-based information resources is persistently validated using automation. Class C: The authenticity and integrity of communications between machine-based information resources is persistently validated using automation.

checks.title: Compliance evidence cannot be altered or deleted

indicators.covers: Every evidence file is hashed, each run is chained to the one before, and the store is locked against change.
indicators.does_not_cover: Integrity of deployed software. This environment deploys none.
indicators.name: Validating Resource Integrity
indicators.statement: Use cryptographic methods to validate the integrity of machine-based information resources.
